title: Every book is a door
description: A book looks quiet and still. But open it, and you can visit a dragon's mountain, the bottom of the sea, or a kitchen in another country — all before lunch.

body.heading: Open the door
paragraphs: A book is a door you can hold in your hands. On one side is your chair, your room and your snack. On the other side is a pirate ship, a snowy forest, or a tiny mouse with a very big problem.

All you need to walk through the door is the first page. Some doors open onto funny places. Some open onto scary places. You can always close the book if a place is too scary — the door will wait for you.

body.heading: Every reader sees a different room
paragraphs: Here is the magic part. When you read about a dragon, the dragon in your head is yours. Nobody else's dragon looks exactly like it — not your friend's, not your teacher's, not even the writer's.
That means every book is really lots of books: one for every person who reads it. Which door will you open today?

takeaway: Every book is a door to another place, and the dragon you imagine is yours alone — no two readers ever see quite the same room.
materials: Any picture book or story book
